newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's a "Focus One".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's a "Focus One".

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it named McDonald's Corp as a "Focus One" stock.
-- raised McDonald's near-term rating to buy from accumulate and kept the long-term rating as a buy.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Merrill Lynch later said the uproar over McDonald's new discount strategy was "misdirected."
-- said after six straight quarters of flattish same store sales, the domestic base shows "signs of life." Merrill said it expects first quarter sales to "turn positive."
-- said currency issues and weak economies are hurting near-term international results. These results "mask strengthening competitive position."
